articles.title: Shocking CCTV: Father-Daughter Crushed by Falling Tree in Delhi’s Kalkaji
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: New Delhi – Chilling CCTV footage from Kalkaji’s Hansraj Sethi Marg shows a neem tree collapsing on a moving bike amid heavy rains on Thursday. The clip captures the tree, weakened by continuous downpour since morning, tilting before crashing onto a father-daughter duo riding past.

body.html:
New Delhi – Chilling CCTV footage from Kalkaji’s Hansraj Sethi Marg shows a neem tree collapsing on a moving bike amid heavy rains on Thursday. The clip captures the tree, weakened by continuous downpour since morning, tilting before crashing onto a father-daughter duo riding past. Both sustained injuries. The incident has sparked outrage over civic negligence and unsafe roads in the capital.

articles.title: Nagpur Horror: Man Ties Wife’s Body to Bike After Hit-and-Run, No One Stops to Help
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Nagpur – In a heart-wrenching incident on Raksha Bandhan (August 9), a 35-year-old man, Amit Yadav, was forced to tie his wife’s lifeless body to his bike after she was run over by a speeding truck on the Nagpur-Jabalpur National Highway.

body.html:
Nagpur – In a heart-wrenching incident on Raksha Bandhan (August 9), a 35-year-old man, Amit Yadav, was forced to tie his wife’s lifeless body to his bike after she was run over by a speeding truck on the Nagpur-Jabalpur National Highway.

Amit and his wife, Gyarsi, were travelling from Nagpur’s Lonara to Karanpur in Madhya Pradesh when a truck hit them near Morphata, knocking Gyarsi onto the road before running her over. The truck driver fled, and despite Amit’s pleas, no passerby stopped to help.

With no assistance, he began his journey home with her body until police intercepted him and sent the remains for post-mortem at Indira Gandhi Medical College. A case of accidental death has been filed, with further action pending the autopsy report.

articles.title: Kerala Woman Seriously Injured After Wild Boars Ram Her Two-Wheeler
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Thiruvananthapuram – In a shocking incident caught on CCTV, a woman identified as Nisa from Peringammala was severely injured when a herd of wild boars rammed into her two-wheeler on August 8. The accident occurred around 3 PM while she was riding home on a quiet route.

body.html:
Thiruvananthapuram – In a shocking incident caught on CCTV, a woman identified as Nisa from Peringammala was severely injured when a herd of wild boars rammed into her two-wheeler on August 8. The accident occurred around 3 PM while she was riding home on a quiet route.

One large boar struck her vehicle, causing her to lose control and fall on the road. Her helmet reportedly came off as the strap wasn’t fastened. Locals rushed to her aid, and she was admitted to a nearby medical college for treatment.
